description:
• Brand introduction:NICEWARM 
• Product description:Warm guardian, creator of comfort.  
• USP (Unique Selling Point):Using renewable biomass pellets as fuel is environmentally friendly and energy-saving, with low carbon dioxide emissions. It can also save heating costs.  
• Payment terms:Selection and setting of payment methods:
Shopify Payments: This is the payment method that Shopify comes with, which is highly integrated with the platform, and can monitor transactions in real time without jumping to a third-party page, with high security and convenient payment process. Using it can avoid transaction costs, and the credit card fee will be reduced with the upgrade of Shopify package. However, the countries and regions currently supported are limited, and the collection may be temporarily detained under special circumstances.
PayPal: As a popular third-party payment tool, it is a common choice of Shopify payment methods. It supports multiple currencies, has a good mobile experience, has a large user base and high trust, but the customer service and account security are relatively unstable, and it needs to jump to the third-party page to pay.
Stripe: It is also a popular third-party payment service choice, which can be well compatible with Shopify payment process. Users do not need to jump to third-party pages when paying, and it also provides more possibilities for customized settlement process operation.
In addition, there are other third-party payment service providers, such as Amazon Pay and Klarna.
Payment account and fund settlement:
Account creation and binding: merchants need to create payment accounts as required and bind them with Shopify stores. For example, when using the Shopify Payments service, merchants need to go through the relevant review process.
Fund settlement cycle: there is a certain period of fund settlement, and the specific time may vary according to the payment method and region. Generally speaking, after the transaction is completed, the funds will be settled in the merchant's account within a certain period of time.
Transaction costs:
Different payment methods have different transaction costs. When using a third-party payment service provider other than Shopify Payments, the merchant needs to pay a handling fee for each transaction, and the specific fee varies according to the store subscription package plan. For example, the third-party transaction fee for the Basic package is 2.0%, the Shopify package is 1.0%, and the Advanced package is 0.5%.
Payment security and risk:
Definition of security responsibility: Shopify will take certain security measures to ensure the security of the payment process, but for the security problems caused by the merchants themselves, such as the disclosure of account information, the merchants need to bear corresponding responsibilities.
Fraud detection and prevention: the payment system has the function of fraud detection, and may monitor and deal with abnormal transactions. However, businesses also need to abide by relevant regulations, such as not participating in fraudulent activities.
Changes and notices of payment terms:
Right to change: Shopify reserves the right to change the payment terms at any time, and merchants need to pay attention to the notice of the platform to understand the latest payment terms.
Notification method: Shopify usually informs merchants of the change of payment terms by e-mail or posting a notice on the platform.
